## `rt.blas_build`

Build a bottom-level acceleration structure (BLAS) from geometry; produces an rt.blas handle.

rt.blas_build(%geometry) {geometry_kind, allow_update?, allow_compaction?, motion?} -> %blas. Build a BLAS from geometry (a host-orchestrated device capability, ADR-0110 provider=host). Effects: GPUCommand + a conservative ambient MemoryReadWrite (writes the AS, reads the geometry). ExternalNondeterminism (AS layout). LOWERING (19b+): vulkan_ray_tracing_context's BLAS build (build_scene_as triangle-soup / build_hair_scene procedural-AABB / the CLAS cluster build). find_rt_misuse: geometry_kind in {triangles,procedural,cluster} (GeometryKindInvalid). STRUCTURAL (1 operand, 1 result): the generated verify_blas_build. The %geometry operand-resource-kind refinement lands with the 19b bridge lowering. allow_update/allow_compaction/motion = DECLARED capability attrs (no engine witness yet — declared != implemented).

## `rt.instance_populate`

## `rt.trace`

A ray-tracing pipeline trace: dispatch raygen over a (width,height,depth) grid against a %tlas with a %sbt + bindings (device-execute, like compute.dispatch).

rt.trace(%width, %height, %depth, %tlas, %sbt, %bindings...) {access="...", max_recursion?}. A ray-tracing pipeline trace (compute.dispatch's sibling — it runs USER shader groups, RESULTLESS). Effects: GPUCommand + a conservative ambient MemoryReadWrite (the raygen/chit do arbitrary bound-buffer writes). LOWERING (19b+): vulkan_ray_tracing_context.trace_rays_pipeline (the raygen/miss/chit SPIR-V from the %sbt, the TLAS at binding 0). find_rt_misuse (the find_dispatch_misuse mirror, contractual order): operand(3) rt.tlas-typed (TlasTypeMismatch); operand(4) rt.sbt-typed (SbtTypeMismatch); dims (operands 0-2) Index-typed (DimNotIndex); each `access` token in {r,w,rw} (AccessTokenInvalid) with token-count == num bindings (== num_operands-5, AccessArityMismatch); each binding (operands 5..) resource-kinded (BindingNotResource); max_recursion >= 1 if present (MaxRecursionInvalid). STRUCTURAL (>=5 operands, 0 results, `access` present+String): the generated verify_trace.
